scientific limitations/integrity: The theorem is restricted to the stated Barmak--Minian family and distinct nonidentity generators. The geometric quotient is the topological orbit of the realization, not a naive abstract simplicial quotient. The general proof is symbolic; finite computations are stress tests only. The exactly dated topology anchor is arXiv:1410.6111v1, whose primary MSC is 55T05. Older construction and covering papers are supporting references; no unverified pre-journal public day is assigned to them. Broader equivariant-poset theory may contain a general result subsuming the example, although no such statement was located in the inspected sources.
title: Free finite-space orbits can collapse while geometric order-complex orbits retain circles
